items.title: Breaking: Vodafone network crash potentially affecting millions of Australians
items.description: A statement from the company says it is aware some customers are experiencing "intermittent issues" with its service and it is urgently investigating.

items.title: 'Find something else': Academics warn of workload as uni rankings released
items.description: Annual university rankings reveal the University of New South Wales is now the highest-rated Australian institution, placing 19th worldwide.

items.title: Live: US and Iran sign agreement to end war
items.description: The US and Iran have signed a memorandum of understanding to end the war and reopen the Strait of Hormuz. Follow live.

items.title: After 27 years, Virginia Trioli takes creative leap and leaves the ABC
items.description: After 27 years as a journalist, broadcaster and program maker at the ABC, Virginia Trioli announces she is leaving to pursue new creative opportunities.

items.title: Walker's breakout Origin performance showed us both sides of his coin
items.description: On Wednesday night, Queensland coach Billy Slater got a glimpse of a glistening Sam Walker-led future, even if the present wasn't quite perfect.

items.title: US-Iran deal covers Lebanon, Strait of Hormuz and Iran's uranium
items.description: The presidents of the United States and Iran have officially signed a memorandum of understanding aimed at ending the war and reopening the Strait of Hormuz.

items.title: Wife and carer 'dumbfounded' by husband's aged care assessment
items.description: Melbourne man Graham Crossan relies on his wife Gaynor to help him eat, move and even breathe. But a new assessment tool means he has been refused funding for more support.

items.title: Couple left with nothing after investing $1m in 7-Eleven franchise
items.description: Jotika and Sunny Sharma took out a loan to purchase their Sydney franchise in 2015. When the lease expired this year, their relationship with the convenience store giant turned ugly.

items.title: Hanson's fiery address creates risk for One Nation
items.description: In one press club appearance, we've learned more about where Hanson stands. And that creates risk for One Nation.

items.title: Live: Ghana struggling against Panama after England's frenetic opening win
items.description: Manchester City star Antoine Semenyo takes the field for Ghana in Toronto, after Harry Kanes nets a brace in England's entertaining 4-2 win over Croatia. Follow live.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video
items.description: Federal agencies including DHS, FBI, and ICE investigate $110 million in suspected fraud at Minnesota child care centers following a viral YouTube video[3].

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
